caption: A gymnast performs a cartwheel across a mat, hands then feet touching the ground in turn.

sa.check: A gymnast performs a cartwheel across a mat.
Hands then feet touch the ground in turn.
The hands touch first, then the feet.

pc.expect: Her hands and feet touch the mat one after another in sequence, her body stays whole, and she bends only at the joints.
pc.fail: A limb detaches; or a limb bends mid-bone; or hands and feet are all down at once mid-wheel.

pc.expect: She stays in contact through hands or feet and lands upright.
pc.fail: She floats; or hovers upside down; or sinks.

pc.expect: Her hands and feet land on the mat, not in it.
pc.fail: They sink; or pass through; or the mat passes through her.

pc.expect: She travels sideways across the mat.
pc.fail: She jumps position; or ends where she started; or reverses mid-wheel.

pc.expect: Her limbs keep their number and stay attached.
pc.fail: A limb vanishes; or a second figure appears; or she merges with the mat.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Her leotard and the mat stay the same.
pc.fail: The leotard changes colour; or the mat changes; or the gym rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Form, posture and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
